Zero-Trust Physics Environments

zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-environments

Answer questions about real hardware using a physics verifier as the one tool, ending with a line the scorer re-runs to check.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • MCP harness integration test
  • tool-grounding evaluation

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

The scorer re-sends the agent's request to the verifier and compares; correct and kept_to_the_tool are each 0 or 1, with no judge.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

python3 selftest.py --engine $ENGINE
python3 prompt.py figure-curiosity-day-3500
python3 score.py my_replies --engine $ENGINE

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-environments --repo-type dataset --local-dir zero-trust-physics-environments

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-environments --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Python 3; Rust 1.88 to build the verifier, or the open MCP endpoint.

Evidence

All 170 references were checked against the verifier; frontier tool-enabled agents reach up to 99.3%.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
